subject: general
question: As per VarIndia (April 2025), India’s draft ‘6G THz Testbed’ specifically targets components operating in frequencies above:
solution:
The Correct answer is __**100 GHz**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The draft **'6G THz Testbed'** proposed by India is an initiative aimed at advancing **next-generation communication technologies**.
 
• India's testbed focuses on components operating in frequencies above **100 GHz**, marking a significant step towards achieving 6G capabilities.
 
• **6G technology** is expected to utilize higher frequency bands, including **terahertz (THz)** frequencies, to enable faster data transmission and enhanced connectivity.
 
• Frequencies above **100 GHz** are crucial for enabling **ultra-high-speed data transfer**, low latency, and improved energy efficiency in communication systems.
 
• The development of technologies operating above **100 GHz** facilitates applications such as **autonomous driving, holographic communication**, and **advanced IoT systems**.
 
• This initiative aligns with India's vision to become a global leader in **telecommunication technology** and contribute to the evolution of **6G networks**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **60 GHz**__

 __
 
• **60 GHz** is typically associated with **WiGig technology**, which is used for high-speed wireless communications over short distances.
 
• This frequency band is utilized for applications such as **wireless docking stations** and **high-definition video streaming**.
 
• Though useful, it does not meet the requirements for the extreme data rates expected in **6G communication systems**.
 
 
 
• **300 GHz**__
 __
 
• **300 GHz** falls within the **terahertz (THz) spectrum**, which is expected to play a crucial role in **6G networks**.
 
• However, the focus of India's draft testbed is specifically on frequencies above **100 GHz**, making this option incorrect in the given context.
 
 
 
• **6 GHz**__
 
 
• **6 GHz** is commonly used in **Wi-Fi 6E**, which provides enhanced wireless connectivity for devices.
 
• This frequency band is not suitable for the high-speed and low-latency requirements of **6G networks**.
